assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, setbacks, green ratio, road redlines, ownership, utilities, fire and heritage controls are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Land use and building footprints express relationships only and cannot support permitting or demolition.

assumptions.statement: The repository rough provisional boundary is used unchanged for generation and intake checks.
assumptions.impact: Every area-sensitive layer and metric must be recalculated when official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: PROV-KEY-003 is not anchored to Dazhongsi Station and includes the Beijing North Station vicinity.
assumptions.impact: Station integration and four-quadrant design remain directional; no precise alignment is proposed.

assumptions.statement: No site visit, acoustic measurement or accessibility audit was performed.
assumptions.impact: Phase 0 establishes the baseline; no current acoustic performance is claimed.

assumptions.statement: No resident, enterprise, operator, disability-group or property-owner interview was performed.
assumptions.impact: Personas and thresholds are hypotheses, not evidence of local endorsement.

assumptions.statement: No government unit, operator, budget or approval has been assigned to the proposed pilots.
assumptions.impact: Only reversible, equipment-free public-space actions may proceed before accountability is assigned.

assumptions.statement: Default public operation creates or retains no raw audio and performs no voiceprint, identity or emotion inference.
assumptions.impact: Any exception requires separate approval, narrow scope, public notice and independent review.
